newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: TDK Manila unit eyes 18.309 bln peso plant.
newsitem.headline: TDK Manila unit eyes 18.309 bln peso plant.

text.p: TDK Corp unit Components Manufacturer is investing 18.309 billion pesos in the Philippines over the next five years, documents released by the Philippine Economic Zone Authority on Thursday said.
Components Manufacturer, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of TDK Corp of Japan, is putting up a production faciltity inside the Laguna Technopark to manufacture magnetic heads and their components.
The plant is projected to produce an average of 145.38 million units in the next five years with average annual sales of $1.652 billion during the period.
Construction on the 83,815 square metre lot has started and would be completed by January next year. Commercial operations are scheduled to start in March 1998.
